data.name: Imtithal
data.long_meaning: The name Imtithal is derived from the Arabic root 't-th-l', which means 'to preserve', 'to protect', or 'to keep'. In Islamic tradition, the name represents the concept of preserving the faith, the soul, or the relationship with Allah. This name is often given to girls, symbolizing their role as protectors and preservers in their families and communities.
